name: ordinal_word
description: Convert a digit 1-12 into its English ordinal word (third, seventh). Control converts the same digit to its cardinal word (three, seven).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
O=['first','second','third','fourth','fifth','sixth','seventh','eighth','ninth','tenth','eleventh','twelfth']
C=['one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine','ten','eleven','twelve']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
    n=random.randint(1,12)
    items.append({"prompt":f"Words for numbers. Position {n} in a race, written as an ordinal word, is the","answer":" "+O[n-1]})
    control.append({"prompt":f"Words for numbers. The number {n}, written as a cardinal word, is","answer":" "+C[n-1]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
